title: Lead Management System Offer for B2B Businesses
summary: The speaker promotes a lead management system that can be sold to B2B or service businesses. It includes a dashboard for tracking leads (hot, warm, cold), handling calls and WhatsApp, and filtering qualified versus unqualified leads. They promise to share the full source code and files, which can be edited with VS Code, Codex, or Cloud Code. The data layer can be a Google Sheet, Airtable, or any other database. Viewers are asked to comment to receive a link and further instructions. The solution is presented as customizable and ready for resale.
